data_fields.name: reagent_delay_bucket
data_fields.donor_constant: moves & 0xF0 (values 0..240 step 16); grant refused while equal to last grant bucket

best_idea: Gate a pickup on world state first, then grant it once (refuse if already owned) or as a capped stack that reports the overflow, with a cooldown keyed to the move counter.
decision_why: Keep gate-then-grant, the move-bucket cooldown and the capped stack that reports overflow; move ownership into a server check inside the grant, use a seeded server roll, and drop the mystic +8 farm. Donor has no bag, bank or equipment slots, so those parts are new work.
acceptance: A server test searches the same reagent location twice inside one move bucket and asserts the second search grants nothing; a stack at 95 granted 9 caps at 99 and reports dropped 5, which the client shows as a Dropped some line.
